propositions.proposition: 任何掩饰犯罪收益获取、处置、来源或隐瞒犯罪收益的行为，将受到监禁和罚款。

propositions.proposition: 《禁止恐怖融资及大规模杀伤性武器扩散法》要求金融机构通过识别和报告可疑交易及冻结资产来防止恐怖融资。
source_quotes: this act imposes obligations on financial institutions to prevent the financing of terrorism by identifying and reporting suspicious transactions and freezing assets.
